format: UCWDC Couples age for the Dance Season

source.quote_free_summary: A competitor's age for the entire Dance Season is the age they will be on the last day of that Dance Season; the Dance Season runs from January 16 to January 15.

requirement: Competition OS does not compute UCWDC age. The age_basis for UCWDC Couples would record dance_season_end with the stated season boundaries; mapping an event to a season is a DanceFlow derivation and unresolved for multi-day events spanning January 15-16.
enforcement_point: Not built. Design only (docs/competition/governance/editions/OD-30-rulebook-editions-design.md). The OD-03/OD-18 organizer determination is the only age-division control at first activation.
interpretation_notes: EFFECTIVE DATE UNKNOWN: effective_from is a schema-required PLACEHOLDER (the date the governance registry was introduced), NOT a verified effective date; no pinned source states one (OD-30 finding F-1). Season membership of a multi-day event spanning Jan 15-16 is unresolved (OD30-SILENT-0002). Coordinates with UCWDC-OD03-AGE-DIVISIONS-COUPLES (PR #837).
